## Project-level conventions

- Project skill dirs (`.atl/skills`, `skills/`, `.opencode/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.github/skills`, …): none found in `gelium-ui`.
- Project convention files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `GEMINI.md`, `copilot-instructions.md`): none found in `gelium-ui` repo root. User-level convention files exist at `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`, `~/.opencode/AGENTS.md`, `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` (outside project scope; not indexed).

## Loading protocol

1. Match task context and target files against the `Trigger / description` column.
2. Pass only the matching `Path` values to the subagent under `## Skills to load before work`.
3. Instruct the subagent to read those exact `SKILL.md` files before reading, writing, reviewing, testing, or creating artifacts.
4. If no matching skill exists, proceed without project skill injection and report `skill_resolution: none`.
